items.definition:
Resembling a ghost; spectral
A ghostly figure appeared in the old house.

Done or doing constantly or as a habit
His habitual tardiness was starting to annoy his colleagues.

Obscured by haze; vague or unclear
The morning was hazy, making it difficult to see the mountains.

Relating to the Himalayas
The Himalayan mountains are the highest in the world.

Characterized by idealism; unrealistically aiming for perfection
She was young and idealistic, believing she could change the world.

Lacking pity or compassion; cruel
The conditions in the prison were described as inhumane.

Occurring or done in an instant or instantly
The effect of the medicine was instantaneous.

Able to be shown to be right or reasonable; defensible against criticism
His anger was completely justifiable given the circumstances.

newly discovered or acquired
She enjoyed her newfound freedom after graduation.

(of a person) tending to spend much time seated; inactive
A sedentary lifestyle can lead to health problems.

relating to or dependent on a particular situation
His reaction was purely situational, not typical of his character.

having or showing a belief in superstitions
Many people are superstitious about black cats.

(of a person) easily offended or upset
He's very touchy about his age.

free from disturbance; calm
The lake was tranquil in the early morning.

not aware of the presence of danger or trouble
The thief approached the unsuspecting tourist.

resembling an angel, especially in beauty, innocence, or goodness
The child had an angelic smile.

contrary to the laws and customs of society; hostile or harmful to organized society
His antisocial behavior made him unpopular.

open to discussion or argument
Whether it was the right decision is still debatable.

suitable or good enough to live in
Scientists are searching for habitable planets beyond our solar system.

causing a trance-like state; mesmerizing
The rhythmic swaying of the pendulum had a hypnotic effect.

not leading to a firm conclusion or result; not ending doubt or dispute
The evidence was inconclusive, so no charges were filed.

having or showing no skill; clumsy
He was completely inept at sports.

(of a punishment or person in authority) more merciful or tolerant than expected
The judge was lenient with the first-time offender.

wandering; moving from place to place
The nomadic tribes moved with their herds across the plains.

designed to prevent something
Regular exercise is a good preventative measure against heart disease.

expressing deep feeling
Her soulful voice moved the audience.

impossible to break
This glass is made of unbreakable material.

able to adjust to new conditions
He is an adaptable person who can work in any environment.

pleasantly windy; lighthearted and lively
It was a breezy day, perfect for a walk.

failing in duty or law
The company was delinquent in its payments.

relating to cats or the cat family
The lion is a powerful feline creature.

having rough, sharp points protruding
The broken glass had jagged edges.

relating to the Midwest of the United States
She grew up in a small Midwestern town.

dark and gloomy, especially due to thick mist
The water in the pond was murky and dark.

Requiring or using great exertion.
Climbing the mountain was a strenuous activity.

not hurt or damaged
Despite the accident, he emerged unharmed.

too bad or horrific to be expressed in words
The unspeakable horrors of war were depicted in the film.

inspiring a feeling of wonder or delight
The Grand Canyon is a truly wondrous sight.

capable of being put into practice; feasible
We need to find a workable solution to this problem.

Relating to or characteristic of conversation
She has a very natural and conversational style of speaking.

Affected by disease; unhealthy
The diseased tree had to be cut down to prevent the spread of infection.

economical, thrifty
She lives a very frugal life, saving money wherever she can.

fashionable, excellent (informal)
That's a really groovy tune.

relating to electricity generated by hydropower
The dam generates hydroelectric power for the entire region.

Relating to the organization and management of a complex operation
The logistic challenges of the expedition were immense.

Relating to the Maya people or their civilization
The Mayan civilization developed an advanced writing system.

Able to be seen or noticed
The effects of the new policy were immediately observable.

relating to Sicily or its people
They enjoyed traditional Sicilian cuisine during their trip.

having or showing abilities or qualities that are more than human
The athlete showed superhuman strength during the competition.

able to be endured or tolerated
The pain was tolerable after taking the medication.

not yet developed
The land remains undeveloped, preserving its natural beauty.

not able to be touched or affected
The champion seemed untouchable in the final match.

having or expressing a wish for something to happen, especially something that is unlikely
His plans were based on wishful thinking rather than reality.

able to be achieved
Setting realistic and attainable goals is important for success.

mad; crazy
He went absolutely bonkers when he heard the news.

shaped like a cone
The mountain had a distinct conical peak.

warm and friendly
They exchanged cordial greetings before the meeting.

light, thin, and easily damaged; weak and unconvincing
The argument was too flimsy to convince the jury.

easily persuaded to believe something; credulous
He was so gullible that he fell for every prank.

annoying; troublesome
Those pesky flies won't leave me alone.

relating to the sense of touch
The toy had a variety of tactile textures for babies to explore.

not having a license
Driving an unlicensed vehicle is illegal.

not producing much or any useful result
The meeting was unproductive, and nothing was decided.

playfully quaint or fanciful, especially in an appealing and amusing way
She has a whimsical sense of humor.
